description:
Intent: a callable-mapper overload must preserve the mapper input from its producer through activation, demand, transport, and native lowering. Minimal current repro: Enum.with_index(["a", "b"], fn (x, _index) -> x <> "!" end). Interpreter succeeds with ["a!", "b!"], while run and build fail before execution: native clause dispatch required omitted semantic input 1 for the with_index activation.

Trace backward from the omitted BackendExecutable input to the first fact that classified the mapper as non-runtime. Repair that authoritative demand/transport conclusion; do not add a native fallback, recalculate a source shape, or force all inputs live. Preserve omission for genuinely unused overload inputs.

Acceptance: the single-call repro and the string/int/tuple mapper variants from enum_map_family pass interp/run/build with oracle output; telemetry or a focused production-path test pins the mapper input as present at the first model boundary that previously dropped it; no new fallback exists; lib and clippy pass.
title: Preserve Enum.with_index callable mapper input through native lowering
